title: Virtual Care Service Terms: Portal E-Visit Replies, On-Demand Queue and Session Conduct
content:
A Portal E-Visit is answered by a clinician within the visit type's e-visit reply time, counted in business hours from submission; On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care is available during its operating hours and releases a request not picked up within its queue maximum wait. These terms also govern escalation to video, follow-up messages, the after-visit summary and the conduct of a Virtual Care session.

## Terms

1. **E-visit reply.** A Portal E-Visit is answered by a clinician within the visit type's e-visit reply time in business hours of submission. Business hours run from 8:00 to 17:00, Monday to Friday.
2. **Unsubmitted questionnaire.** An unsubmitted e-visit questionnaire expires after the visit type's questionnaire expiry hours.
3. **Escalation to video.** The clinician may escalate an e-visit or phone visit to video without a new charge where the visit type's escalation-to-video setting is Yes.
4. **On-demand availability and queue.** On-Demand Virtual Urgent Care is available during its operating hours; a request not picked up within the queue maximum wait is released as a queue timeout with a full refund.
5. **Follow-up messages.** Follow-up portal messages about the encounter are included for the visit type's included follow-up days.
6. **After-visit summary.** The after-visit summary is posted within the visit type's after-visit summary hours.
7. **Session conduct.** Scheduled sessions last up to the visit type's longest scheduled session; same-day access is offered only where the visit type's same-day setting is Yes; the encounter is staffed by the visit type's clinician type; and an interpreter can join where the visit type's interpreter setting is Yes.

An e-visit questionnaire or an on-demand queue entry becomes an encounter in progress when a clinician picks it up.

## Counting business hours (hypothetical reply time of 8 business hours)

| Submitted | Business hours available that day | Business hours carried to the next weekday | Reply due by |
|---|---|---|---|
| Tuesday 9:00 | 8 (9:00 to 17:00) | 0 | Tuesday 17:00 |
| Tuesday 13:00 | 4 (13:00 to 17:00) | 4 (8:00 to 12:00) | Wednesday 12:00 |

Only hours between 8:00 and 17:00, Monday to Friday, are counted.

## The queue on both sides (hypothetical maximum wait of 90 minutes)

A request enters the on-demand queue at 20:00.

- A clinician picks it up at 20:45: the request becomes an encounter in progress.
- No clinician has picked it up and 90 minutes have passed: the request is released as a queue timeout with a full refund.

## Points of reference

**Does escalating an e-visit to video add a charge?** Not where the visit type's escalation-to-video setting is Yes; the escalation is made without a new charge.

**Is same-day access offered on every visit type?** Only where the visit type's same-day setting is Yes.
